title: PH Navy deploys ships, Marines, air assets for ASEAN Summit security
summary: The Philippine Navy will deploy most of its vessels under the Naval Defense Command (NDC), along with Marines, naval special forces and air assets, to help secure the upcoming ASEAN Summit.
